column1: # The comparisons the weekly Fern goldens run decides with (tools/fern-goldens/weekly.py
# `decide`), over the tree its pull request would carry: crozier's own, run unchanged.
# `scope` item runs the command once per item ({item}); family runs it once for every
# family it names, and a rejection names each item whose name or regenerated paths
# its report mentions. `verdict` exit:PASS/REJECT lists the exits that pass and that
# reject; any other exit is a comparison that could not run. fixtures-report reads
# `report_fixture_diffs`' own summary (a difference outside the corpus's `unmatched`,
# or a generation or processing failure, rejects). docs/fern-goldens.md says which
# family is compared per item and which per family.
